function: Learned channel prediction (Transformer CP-Net) against aging, plus label-free uplink power allocation (MoE-Net, gating WT-Net) for EE/SE under URLLC in aerial-terrestrial cell-free mMIMO (p. 7; p. 9).
system: Uplink TDD cell-free mMIMO: 64 ground and 8 aerial APs, 4 antennas each; single-antenna aerial and ground UEs (1:2); 1.9 GHz; no RIS (p. 3; p. 10).
method: Supervised Transformer encoder (CP-Net) with channel-quality-weighted MSE; label-free CNN mixture of three experts plus gating WT-Net trained on SINR-based objective with URLLC penalty (p. 8; p. 9).
data_channel: Custom simulated Rician (AG, ATA) and Rayleigh (GTG) channels with Bessel-correlation aging; 20,000 samples, 8:2 train/test; OOD set uses 3GPP-inspired LoS switching (p. 4; p. 10; p. 11).
test_conditions: Train/test 8:2 split of 20,000 samples (aerial 20 m/s, ground 10 m/s); extra 1000-sample OOD test set with 3GPP-inspired LoS/NLoS switching on AG links (p. 10; p. 11).
baselines: Channel prediction: nonlinear Kalman (non-learned), LSTM-GRU [39] (learned). Power allocation: SCA (non-learned), lightweight MLP following [23] (learned); ablation variants of the proposed network (p. 10).
metrics: NMSE (dB) for channel prediction; EE (kbits/J), SE (bps/Hz), URLLC satisfaction probability (USP); decision latency in ms (p. 10; p. 12; p. 14).
complexity: Orders: CP-Net O(KMV^2L^2), experts O(KM^2L+KL^2); CP-Net 0.325 ms per link; MoE-Net+WT-Net 0.48-2.70 ms for K = 8-40 (Table VIII) (p. 14).
q1_support: p. 4: "The adopted channel and aging models are used as tractable approximations". Custom Rician/Rayleigh simulator with Bessel aging (Eqs. 1-4); no 3GPP TR 38.901, DeepMIMO or measured data for training; the OOD set only borrows a LoS probability from [41] (p. 11).
q2_support: p. 11: "out-of-distribution (OOD) test set with 1000 independently" randomized samples whose AG channels follow a different (3GPP-inspired LoS/NLoS switching) model than the training data; Fig. 4 (p. 11) and Figs. 10-11 (p. 14) report results on it.
q3_support: p. 10: "SCA algorithm: We employ SCA method [40] as an" iterative benchmark (also Kalman); p. 10: "Lightweight MLP network: Following [23], we implement" (also LSTM-GRU); p. 12: "improves the EE of EE-oriented UEs by 17.36% and 31% over" SCA and MLP.
q4_support: p. 14: "we analyze the computational complexity of the considered methods"; gives O(KMV^2L^2) for CP-Net, O(KM^2L+KL^2) for the experts, 0.325 ms per link, and decision latencies in Table VIII.
q5_support: p. 10: "A total of 20,000 samples are generated and divided into" training and testing sets by the authors; no code or data link, DOI or availability statement appears anywhere in the paper, and no public dataset is used.
notes: Area 6: two learned functions, channel prediction (area 2) and uplink power allocation on aerial and ground links (area 6); 6 precedes 2 in the order of the rule, and CP-Net alone would be area 2. The OOD channel takes only a LoS probability labeled 3GPP-inspired from [41] (p. 11) and is a test set only, so q1=0; reviewer to confirm. Tables I-VIII read from page images.
